acceptance_rules: Every listed fixture must exist and parse as JSON.
The schema must validate against the declared JSON Schema dialect.
Each positive fixture must validate against the schema.
Each negative fixture must fail validation against the schema.
A negative fixture failing for a different reason must be reported separately; it does not satisfy its intended control.
Schema format keywords are not assumed to be assertions unless the validator explicitly enables the Draft 2020-12 format-assertion vocabulary or performs equivalent application-level checks.
Validation proves record structure only; it does not prove factual accuracy, rights ownership, cultural authenticity, consent, or feasibility.
